programs.title: The Fall of Judea
programs.desc: The Fatal Conflict Episode 2 explores the events that shaped the great Jewish revolt against Rome, as recorded by Jewish General, historian and perceived traitor, Flavius Josephus.

programs.title: Birth of a Brotherhood
programs.desc: At the beginning of the 12th century, a few knights decide to create a new brotherhood called "The order of the Temple".

programs.title: A business empire
programs.desc: In the middle of the 12th century, the order of the Temple becomes increasingly popular among the kings and peoples of Western Europe.

programs.title: The fall of the order
programs.desc: At the end of the 13th century, as Christian holdings in the holy land have disappeared, the Templars continue to push for a new crusade.

programs.title: In the Footsteps of Jesus
programs.desc: For the past 2000 years, he has remained the most famous character of History. Described as a leader, as a feminist, an anarchist, a healer. But today, what do we really know about Jesus?

programs.title: Faith and Power
programs.desc: The subject of the episode is a mysterious mass death of children in ancient Athens, the Great Fire of Rome under Emperor Nero and a fanatical destruction of temples in ancient Egypt.

programs.title: Secrets of the Dead
programs.desc: This episode is about a dark conspiracy against Ramses III, the mysterious multiple killing of a Celtic druid and the brutal murder of a Neolithic family from Eulau in Saxony.

programs.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922
programs.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programs.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928
programs.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programs.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933
programs.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programs.title: The Racial State 1933-1934
programs.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programs.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938
programs.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programs.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programs.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programs.title: Auschwitz One Day
programs.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.

programs.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
programs.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programs.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programs.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programs.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programs.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programs.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programs.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programs.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programs.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.
